purpose: Delivery acceptance requirements and evidence baseline; not an admission or release receipt.

field_accounting.required: Every observed source field has a stable native identity, source path or cell address, occurrence denominator, state and evidence or an explicit unresolved reason.
field_accounting.native_preservation: Native value, presence/null/blank, type, formula/error and lexical date or amount survive even where meaning or conversion is unresolved.
field_accounting.interpretation: Promotion requires source-bound meaning evidence; a structural destination, typed parse or successful consumer is insufficient.
field_accounting.unavailable: A requested capability or field unavailable in the exact source is explicit; absence does not establish a negative domain fact.
field_accounting.header_and_value_denominators: Header meanings and individual native-value meanings are separate; never sum overlays or classify all values from the header state.

consumer_requirements.behavior: Return bounded source-faithful observations with native identifier/path and field state; unresolved values remain displayable and countable as source observations.
Bind source/acquisition, immutable revision/path, payload digest, schema era, lineage, rights record, semantic evidence and v4 admission to the same output.
Return coverage denominator, missing periods, interpretation limits and unavailable capabilities without implying current status or completeness.
Verify actual admitted revisions through bounded API, CLI, Atlas and deterministic export canaries; raw-reader and fixture success are insufficient.
Reject or return explicitly unavailable unsupported pooling, current status, historical equivalence, patient rates, payable benefit, patient cost and clinical eligibility.

conditional_claims.condition: A consumer asserts a converted date, amount, benefit, historical equivalence or change event.
conditional_claims.evidence_required: Exact source-era rule, native states, conversion limits, lineage and qualified snapshots; retain P7 ambiguity when no rule is selected.

conditional_claims.condition: A consumer asserts PBS item/product identity, restriction meaning, currency, price basis, listing interval or funding status.
conditional_claims.evidence_required: Exact-source domain semantics; source structure or labels alone do not establish the domain assertion.

conditional_claims.condition: A consumer promotes broader matching or semantic links beyond the accepted exact same-record MBS set.
conditional_claims.evidence_required: Real reviewed examples, negative controls, matcher/version/threshold binding and calibration limits. Literal matches remain diagnostics; abstention is valid.
Two qualified snapshots, schema-era and temporal roles, complete declared cohort denominator and explicit missing-source limits.

separate_obligations: Exact output qualification, rights, publication, v4 admission and actual consumer delivery.
Independent administrative/geographical recovery and its existing RPO/RTO contract.
M-105 chronology disposition, M-106 patient denominator and M-107 unavailable delivery/coverage; no outreach is permitted.
Existing M-108 product obligations and compatibility commitments.
Stable v1 exact-candidate conditions and signed release package using existing approval.
